entries.en: therefore; for that reason.
because of you; for your sake.
entries.notes: L 栏缩写「por ty.」推向 por ti，H 栏「因汝」互证。

entries.zh: 因为那个；由于那事（「&.」示同类推及）。
entries.en: for that one; on account of that (etc.).
for this; on this account.
entries.notes: H 栏「只上」次字功能不明，疑衍字或复合，依「因只」定夺。

entries.zh: 为言辞争辩不休；口角相争。
entries.en: to wrangle over words; to contend verbally.
entries.notes: M 栏三处 [残]，仅存 sioche、jûchī 片段，依 L「porfiar a la palabra」与 H「相諍」定夺。

entries.en: to contend; to quarrel; to strive.
entries.notes: 「por fiar」为同页 porfiar 的分写形式，H「争」可证。

entries.en: to be obstinate; to insist stubbornly.
entries.notes: H 栏存 [疑:拘] 标记，按 拗（Hokkien àu，执拗）与 M 栏 âu 定夺。

entries.en: to fight; to come to blows.
entries.notes: H 作「傷陣」而 M 对音 sio-tin 近「相陣」（对阵相斗），暂释为争斗动武，字面仍存疑。

entries.en: to provoke; to goad; to push back hard.
to blame and berate each other; mutual recrimination.
entries.notes: H 末字作「賊」而 M「cheg」合「責」（tsik），疑原稿讹写，按「相刻責」释。

entries.en: to work oneself into anger; to get heated.
to be stubbornly argumentative; to talk back hard.
entries.notes: R 栏「perible.」不成官话对音，疑杂入他语，未据以释义。

entries.en: to bicker; to give free rein to one's tongue.

entries.zh: 弄假成真；以假充真（纠缠以求成事）。
entries.en: to pass off falsehood as truth; to keep up a pretence to win one's end.
entries.notes: L 就「求成于女子」立义、H 就「以假充真」立义，以「作假纠缠以成事」相贯。

entries.en: to strive to succeed; to win honour by contending.
entries.notes: L 栏「guia」与上条「niña」对举，疑指引导之人或为异文；H「争氣」义明。

entries.en: to brawl and wrangle without cause.
entries.notes: H 栏夹 [疑:殿/拗]，首字作「毆」、次字「百」不可解，全词义难确诂，故 low。

entries.en: firm and unyielding; stubbornly resolute.
entries.notes: H 栏存 [疑:恣] 标记，M 栏 quién quiàng 合「堅強」，依此定夺。

entries.zh: 硬碰硬；两个都是好争执的人。
entries.en: hard against hard; two stubborn quarrellers.
crafty; to wrangle craftily in a lawsuit.
to argue over right and wrong.
entries.notes: M 末字 quy 与「非」对音不合，疑原稿误写，依 H、L 定夺。

entries.en: litigation; lawsuit.
